items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was a strong influence, coming from playing with Mongo’s band.

ctx.x: That’s right. He played on No, You’d Better Not, and also Martin Banks, the trumpet player, played a trumpet solo on that.
Right. He’s on there. Garnett Brown on trombone, Benny Powell, Jimmy Owens, Chris White on bass, Carmelo Garcia, Victor Pantoya. So still in the Latin – a lot of the Latin influence.
Right. That was a strong influence, coming from playing with Mongo’s band.
